name: Sime Darby Property Berhad
overview: Sime Darby Property 今年在柔佛 Kulai 收购约 556.96 英亩永久地契土地（RM418.5 million），并通过合资公司 Kerayong Development Consortium 参与约 1,021.93 英亩土地收购；同时收购吉隆坡 Wisma UNIRAZAK 办公楼（RM160.0 million），并完成 Sabah 子公司自愿清盘。
overview_en: Sime Darby Property acquired approximately 556.96 acres of freehold land in Kulai, Johor for RM418.5 million, participated in the acquisition of approximately 1,021.93 acres of land through the Kerayong Development Consortium joint venture, acquired the Wisma UNIRAZAK office building in Kuala Lumpur for RM160.0 million, and completed the members' voluntary liquidation of its Sabah subsidiary.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年在柔佛 Kulai 收购土地，并通过合资公司参与 Kerayong 土地收购，以扩大土地储备。
segments.note_en: Acquired land in Kulai, Johor and participated in the Kerayong land acquisition through a joint venture to expand land bank.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sime Darby Property (Kulai) Sdn Bhd 与 SD Guthrie Berhad 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM418.5 million 收购位于柔佛 Kulai、Senai 约 556.96 英亩永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sime Darby Property (Kulai) Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with SD Guthrie Berhad to acquire approximately 556.96 acres of freehold land in Senai, Kulai, Johor for RM418.5 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Sime Darby Property (Kerayong) Sdn Bhd 向合资公司 Kerayong Development Consortium Sdn Bhd 注资，该合资公司之全资子公司签订两份买卖协议，收购约 1,021.93 英亩土地。
actions.text_en: Sime Darby Property (Kerayong) Sdn Bhd injected capital into joint venture Kerayong Development Consortium Sdn Bhd, whose wholly-owned subsidiaries entered into two sale and purchase agreements to acquire approximately 1,021.93 acres of land.

segments.name: 投资
segments.note: 今年收购吉隆坡 Wisma UNIRAZAK 办公楼，作为投资物业。
segments.note_en: Acquired the Wisma UNIRAZAK office building in Kuala Lumpur as an investment property.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Sime Darby Property (KLGCC Resort) Sdn Bhd 与 Permodalan Nasional Berhad 签订买卖协议，正式落实 Wisma UNIRAZAK 的 RM160.0 million 收购。
actions.text_en: Sime Darby Property (KLGCC Resort) Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Permodalan Nasional Berhad, formalising the RM160.0 million acquisition of Wisma UNIRAZAK.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sime Darby Property (KLGCC Resort) Sdn Bhd 接受 Permodalan Nasional Berhad 的意向书，以 RM160.0 million 收购 Wisma UNIRAZAK 十五层办公楼及一层地下停车场。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sime Darby Property (KLGCC Resort) Sdn Bhd accepted a letter of offer from Permodalan Nasional Berhad to acquire the fifteen-storey Wisma UNIRAZAK office building with one level of basement carpark for RM160.0 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成 Sabah 子公司自愿清盘，并引入 EPF 作为新经济创投基金的有限合伙人。
segments.note_en: Completed the members' voluntary liquidation of the Sabah subsidiary and admitted EPF as a limited partner in the new economy venture funds.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sime Darby Property (Sabah) Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日举行最终会议，完成自愿清盘程序，预计于 2027 年 2 月 4 日解散。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sime Darby Property (Sabah) Sdn Bhd held its final meeting on 30 October 2026, completing its members' voluntary liquidation, and is expected to be dissolved on 4 February 2027.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Employees Provident Fund 于 2026 年 6 月 9 日签署协议，成为 Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture PLT 及 Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture Partners PLT 的有限合伙人。
actions.text_en: The Employees Provident Fund entered into agreements on 9 June 2026 to become a limited partner in Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture PLT and Sime Darby Property New Economy Venture Partners PLT.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 完成 Sabah 子公司 Sime Darby Property (Sabah) Sdn Bhd 的自愿清盘，退出该子公司业务。
model_changes.text_en: Completed the members' voluntary liquidation of Sabah subsidiary Sime Darby Property (Sabah) Sdn Bhd, exiting the subsidiary's operations.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 引入 Employees Provident Fund 作为新经济创投基金的有限合伙人，扩大基金合作架构。
model_changes.text_en: Admitted the Employees Provident Fund as a limited partner in the new economy venture funds, expanding the fund partnership structure.
